title: Nourishing Crisp Polish Beef Shin Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Polish stew made with beef shin, simmered to perfection and finished with a crispy crust, perfect for a family dinner. This low-calorie-friendly dish is also kid-friendly and can be served with a side of crusty bread or over mashed potatoes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the beef shin pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the pot and saute the onion and carrots until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, flour, beef broth, and thyme to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven, simmering for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and increase the oven temperature to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the lid from the pot and return it to the oven, baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the top is crispy and golden brown.
